title: The router's gap expert treats a _gaps.md entry closed by a Closed, Partly resolved or Narrowed line as open and answers 'the kb lacks it'
goal: A _gaps.md entry whose continuation lines close it (Closed, Partly resolved, Narrowed, as well as Resolved and Superseded) is not routed as an open gap: rag.py pack 'What does the kb say about GitLab semantic versioning requirement for Catalog releases?' prints the article that answers it (arch/gitlab-ci-components.md), not kb lacks from _gaps.md:310; rag.py eval keeps passing all its rows.

run: import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','What does the kb say about GitLab semantic versioning requirement for Catalog releases?'],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and 'routed by kind: gap' not in r.stdout and r.stdout.startswith('coverage: ') else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;w=('Closed','Partly resolved','Narrowed','Resolved','Superseded');bad=[x for x in w if not kbfacts.OPEN_GAP.search('  - '+x+' 2026-09-28: a note')];print('closers not read:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

clauses.clause: A _gaps.md entry whose continuation lines close it (Closed, Partly resolved, Narrowed, as well as Resolved and Superseded) is not routed as an open gap: rag.py pack 'What does the kb say about GitLab semantic versioning requirement for Catalog releases?' prints the article that answers it (arch/gitlab-ci-components.md), not kb lacks from _gaps.md:310
rag.py eval keeps passing all its rows

notes: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-7n3d4jte on 2026-10-12 (S2): kbfacts.OPEN_GAP matches only '- Resolved|Superseded'. Also _gaps.md:268 (Closed); 16 'Partly resolved' and 3 'Narrowed' entries (_gaps.md:1064, 1066, 1068): whether a partly resolved entry still routes as open is the planner's choice. Premise run 2026-10-12: the repro pack prints coverage none, routed by kind: gap from _gaps.md:310 (a Closed entry); the closers check fails for Closed, Partly resolved and Narrowed. Choice made at planning: all five closers end the open-gap route as the goal says; the entry stays in the ledger as state (audit --entries still lists it). rag.py eval and tests -k pack_routes_kind pass before the work: they pin behaviour that must stay. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 2 of 19, "Lookup correctness: router experts, the tag parser and aliases answer what the kb holds"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed.
